+===== RDSM
+
+The Root Domain Security Manager (RDSM) is an M-mode component that retains
+access to the entire physical address space and all platform resources.
+
+To support CoVE and CoVE-IO, the RDSM must implement the Supervisor Domain
+Access Protection privileged architecture extension (see <<Smmtt>>). This
+extension provides the hardware enforcement mechanism necessary for isolating
+security domains.
+
+Additionally, the RDSM must implement the CoVE-IO TSM Extension
+(xref:09-coveio_abi.adoc#cove-io-tsm-extension-eid-0x434f5654-covt[COVT]) ABI.
+This interface enables the TSM to request privileged I/O operations, such as
+programming PCIe IDE keys or configuring Root Ports, which typically require
+M-mode privileges.
